shortDescription: SSC has released Final Marks for CPO SI 2024 (Delhi Police & CAPFs). Candidates can download marks via SSC login; final marks notice dated around 24 July 2026.
content:
The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has published Final Marks for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination, 2024.

Key milestones: Paper-I (Jun 2024) → PET/PST → Paper-II (08 Mar 2025) → Medical → Final result & marks. Final marks link activated for candidates on the SSC portal.

How to download

  • Login at ssc.gov.in
  • Use Registration ID and Password
  • Download Final Marks and related write-up PDF from Notice Board

Cut-offs and last selected candidates’ marks/DOB were published earlier with the final result. Keep your scorecard saved for future reference.
